fix(release): pass --tag when generating docs/changelog.json

The new tag doesn't exist yet when this git-cliff invocation runs
(git tag -a happens later in the script), unlike the CHANGELOG.md
call which already passes --tag. Without it, the pending release's
commits have no version to attach to in the JSON context, and any
config with render_always would render them as Unreleased forever.

fix(client): resolve board id via get_board_id in get_card_labels

get_card_labels resolved a missing board_id through a non-blocking
try_lock() on the config, silently falling back to a hardcoded board
id (483) whenever the lock was contended. Use get_board_id().await
instead, which awaits the lock and returns the real configured board.

feat(comments): add follow-up flag and custom date to comment posting

Extend post_comment across all entry points (CLI, MCP, REPL, TUI) to
support:
- --follow flag to mark a comment for follow-up notifications,
  mirroring the site's own "follow" checkbox (only sent when set)
- optional date override so comments can be backdated/postdated,
  validated against COMMENT_DATE_FORMAT ("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M",
  server-local time)

Add resolve_comment_date to parse and validate user-supplied dates,
defaulting to Local::now() when omitted. TUI gains a dedicated date
input field (Tab to focus, Ctrl+F to toggle follow) alongside the
comment text box.

commits.message: sync board_number when switching boards in the TUI
commits.body:
move_card and get_task were resolving the board with a hardcoded 483,
so operations run after switching boards in the live selector kept
hitting the previous board. HteamClient::set_board_number now updates
board_number in memory and invalidates the cached board_id, and
switch_to_board calls it whenever the TUI changes boards.

- Add HteamClient::set_board_number to keep board_number/board_id in sync
- Replace hardcoded board 483 fallback in move_card/get_task with
  get_board_number()
- Fall back to the last workshift record for get_user_id when
  /tr/workingonit/user/ has nothing, and extract cache_user_id to persist it
- Add truncate_for_error to truncate API error snippets by char instead of
  byte, avoiding a panic on multibyte characters

commits.message:
ci(release): fix gh release create race and skip-when-nothing-to-bump

- Drop --verify-tag on gh release create: the tag is always pushed by
  this same job right before this step, so verification is redundant
  and can hit GitHub's matching-refs API before it reflects the tag
  just pushed, aborting with "no matches found for".
- Don't fail when there's nothing to bump: ci/chore/docs/style/test/
  build-only commits are skipped by git-cliff's bump parsers, so an
  automatic run can compute the current latest tag unchanged. Only
  fail hard when an explicit version was requested and collides with
  an existing tag.

  and can hit GitHub's matching-refs API before it reflects the tag
  just pushed, aborting with "no matches found for".
- Don't fail when there's nothing to bump: ci/chore/docs/style/test/
  build-only commits are skipped by git-cliff's bump parsers, so an
  automatic run can compute the current latest tag unchanged. Only
  fail hard when an explicit version was requested and collides with
  an existing tag.

commits.message:
refactor(core): extract shared operations and tui widgets modules

Business logic living inside cli, tui and mcp was duplicated across the
three surfaces, making it hard to keep them consistent. Introduce
src/operations as the single place for domain logic (boards, cards,
checkin, comments, daily_work, projects, reminders, session, users,
working); cli, tui and mcp now act as thin adapters that call into it
and only decide how to present the result.

Also extract src/tui/widgets (popup, scroll, text_input) so popups
share the same scroll-state, text-input-state and centered-popup
rendering boilerplate instead of reimplementing it individually.
